name: Regent Carlton Cannes
insider_take: This palatial Belle Époque masterpiece has been the epicenter of Cannes glamour since 1911, hosting royalty, movie stars, and film festival legends on the world's most famous seaside boulevard.
whats_special: The Regent Carlton sits directly on La Croisette with its own private beach, while the hotel's iconic twin cupolas were inspired by the breasts of Belle Otero, a famous 19th-century courtesan. The seventh floor has been entirely dedicated to luxury suites, many with wraparound terraces offering panoramic Mediterranean views.
pro_tip: Book a sea-facing suite during the Cannes Film Festival (May) for front-row seats to celebrity spotting, or visit in September when rates drop but the weather remains perfect for beach lounging.
dont_miss: The legendary Bar des Célébrités for champagne cocktails, the hotel's private beach club with premium sun loungers, and a sunset stroll along La Croisette to the Palais des Festivals, just 5 minutes away. The hotel's concierge can arrange exclusive access to nearby luxury boutiques and yacht charters.
pros: Iconic Belle Époque palace on La Croisette with legendary grandeur
Prime beachfront location steps from Cannes Film Festival venues
Luxurious suites with private terraces and Mediterranean sea views
World-class spa and Michelin-starred dining experiences
cons: Historic building with some traditional room layouts
